title: Director, Customer Success, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h3>Position overview</h3> <p>GitLab is looking for a strategic, commercially minded, and operationally rigorous Director of Customer Success to lead our EMEA Customer Success Management &amp; Architecture (CSMA) and Customer Success Engineering (CSE) organizations.</p> <p>This leader will own the regional customer-success operating model across relationship management, adoption architecture, technical enablement, customer health, and outcome realization. The role brings together the strengths of CSMA and CSE so customers can move from implementation to adoption, measurable business outcomes, expansion, and renewal with a consistent experience.</p> <p>You will lead through managers and senior leaders, build a high-performing all-remote organization, and partner closely with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Support, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success Operations.</p> <h3>What you will do</h3> <h4>Set the regional customer-success strategy</h4> <ul> <li>Translate GitLab’s customer-outcomes strategy into a clear EMEA plan for CSMA and CSE.</li> <li>Define the regional engagement model, coverage strategy, segmentation, capacity model, and operating rhythm across dedicated, pooled, and scaled motions.</li> <li>Establish a single view of the customer journey, from onboarding and implementation through adoption, optimization, expansion, and renewal.</li> <li>Ensure the organization consistently connects GitLab adoption to customer-defined business outcomes—not activity, features, or meetings alone.</li> <li>Represent EMEA customer needs and patterns in global Customer Success strategy and planning.</li> </ul> <h4>Lead CSMA and CSE as one integrated organization</h4> <ul> <li>Build strong alignment between CSMA relationship leadership and CSE technical expertise, with clear roles, handoffs, decision rights, and escalation paths.</li> <li>Ensure every appropriate customer has a current success plan with measurable outcomes, milestones, owners, risks, and next actions.</li> <li>Create a consistent approach to adoption architecture, use-case progression, technical enablement, and value realization.</li> <li>Develop scalable programs—such as webinars, hands-on labs, office hours, adoption plays, and executive engagements—that increase customer reach and impact.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services to create continuity from implementation through adoption, including high-quality handoffs and clear ownership after delivery.</li> <li>Ensure CSE capacity is focused on the moments that most improve adoption, time-to-value, customer health, and expansion readiness.</li> </ul> <h4>Drive adoption, outcomes, and GitLab platform value</h4> <ul> <li>Make product adoption and verified customer outcomes the centre of the operating model.</li> <li>Build the capabilities required to help customers adopt GitLab’s strategic use cases, including GitLab Duo and the Duo Agent Platform where relevant to customer objectives.</li> <li>Use product-usage data, customer feedback, success-plan progress, and health signals to identify risk and prioritize intervention.</li> <li>Establish repeatable plays to accelerate onboarding, remove adoption blockers, increase breadth and depth of use, and support customers in achieving measurable value.</li> <li>Partner with Sales and Renewal Management to turn adoption progress and outcome evidence into a credible expansion and renewal narrative.</li> </ul> <h4>Own operational excellence and business performance</h4> <ul> <li>Establish a disciplined cadence for forecasting, customer health, risk management, pipeline inspection, capacity planning, and performance reviews.</li> <li>Define a balanced scorecard for CSMA and CSE that includes customer outcomes, adoption, retention health, expansion influence, coverage, productivity, quality, and team development.</li> <li>Improve data quality and operational consistency across Gainsight, Salesforce, reporting dashboards, and other systems of record.</li> <li>Ensure customer escalations are handled with clear ownership, appropriate executive engagement, and timely cross-functional coordination.</li> <li>Identify systemic friction in the customer journey and lead continuous-improvement initiatives that scale across EMEA and globally.</li> </ul> <h4>Build and develop an exceptional team</h4> <ul> <li>Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing CSMA and CSE leaders and practitioners across EMEA.</li> <li>Set clear expectations for customer leadership, technical depth, commercial acumen, operational discipline, and collaboration.</li> <li>Create career paths, enablement plans, mentoring programs, and succession plans for both disciplines.</li> <li>Foster an inclusive, accountable, and high-trust culture consistent with GitLab’s values and all-remote ways of working.</li> <li>Use talent, capacity, and organizational design decisions to ensure the team can support a changing portfolio and evolving product strategy.</li> </ul> <h4>Partner across the revenue and product ecosystem</h4> <ul> <li>Build trusted relationships with regional Sales and Renewal Management leaders while maintaining clear accountability for CS-owned outcomes and signals.</li> <li>Partner with Professional Services on shared customer plans, implementation-to-adoption transitions, and services attach opportunities.</li> <li>Bring structured customer insight to Product, Engineering, Support, Marketing, and Enablement.</li> <li>Orchestrate executive engagement for strategic customers and high-severity risks.</li> <li>Collaborate with global Customer Success leaders to standardize what should scale and preserve the regional adaptations that improve customer impact.</li> </ul> <h3>What success looks like</h3> <ul> <li>Customers achieve measurable outcomes and progress through their intended GitLab use cases.</li> <li>CSMA and CSE operate as one coordinated team with clear ownership, effective handoffs, and a consistent customer experience.</li> <li>Adoption, customer health, renewal risk, and expansion signals are visible, accurate, and acted on early.</li> <li>GitLab’s strategic capabilities—including Duo and the Duo Agent Platform—are adopted in ways that align to customer priorities and measurable value.</li> <li>EMEA improves time-to-value, retention health, customer advocacy, and expansion influence.</li> <li>The organization has strong leadership depth, healthy talent pipelines, and a culture of accountability and continuous learning.</li> <li>Operating metrics and forecasts are trusted by regional and global leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>What you bring</h3> <ul> <li>Significant leadership experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, or a related post-sales function in an enterprise SaaS or subscription software business.</li> <li>Experience leading both customer-facing relationship teams and technical customer-facing teams, ideally through managers and senior managers.</li> <li>A track record of improving customer adoption, measurable outcomes, retention, and expansion in complex enterprise accounts.</li> <li>Experience designing or scaling coverage models across dedicated, pooled, digital, or programmatic customer-success motions.</li> <li>Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, success planning, health and risk management, adoption metrics, and renewal/expansion partnership.</li> <li>Ability to lead technical and business conversations with senior customer stakeholders, including executives, technology leaders, and engineering audiences.</li> <li>Strong operational discipline, including forecasting, capacity planning, KPI design, data quality, and inspection cadences.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to influence across Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, Support, and Operations.</li> <li>Experience hiring, developing, and retaining distributed teams across multiple countries and cultures.</li> <li>Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills.</li> <li>Experience with DevSecOps, software development lifecycle, developer platforms, or enterprise technology transformation.</li> <li>Experience leading adoption of AI, developer productivity, security, or platform capabilities.</li> <li>Familiarity with customer-success platforms and revenue systems such as Gainsight and Salesforce.</li> <li>Experience operating in a high-growth, global, all-remote company.</li> <li>Experience building scaled enablement programs, technical communities, or pooled specialist models.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh)&nbsp;</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today’s hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Predictable performance, even at scale </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Secure, compliant environments by default&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Real-time observability and profiling built in </span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack </span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. </span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Our values:&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">🌿 We make a positive impact.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">✨ We aim for the stars.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">💚 We care for each other.&nbsp;</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Impact of a Product Manager</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">As a Product Manager at Upsun, you own a significant area of Upsun Cloud, our cloud application platform, and the outcomes it delivers for the developers who build on it. The team you join owns the platform's foundations: the API, the runtime, environments, and the reliability every application running on Upsun depends on. And because Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love, much of what you build will be used by AI agents as much as by people.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on, technically rich role that bridges product strategy and deep infrastructure understanding. You own the strategy and the roadmap for your area, working closely with engineering to define platform behavior, build scalable abstractions, and shape workflows that empower modern development teams. Throughout, you act as the key voice for the user, making sure everything we ship contributes meaningfully to an exceptional developer experience.</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Strategy and roadmap:</strong> Own the strategy, roadmap, and priorities for your area of Upsun Cloud, balancing established foundations with uncharted territory.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Problem definition:</strong> Synthesize inputs from customers, support, sales, and engineering into clear problem statements, constructively testing underlying assumptions.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Solution definition:</strong> Explore options with your team, weigh trade-offs, and land on the right scope.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Ship small, iterate fast:</strong> Release in increments and shorten the loop between shipping and learning.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Technical execution:</strong> Collaborate with engineering (especially infrastructure and systems teams) to deliver platform capabilities that are reliable, scalable, and developer-friendly.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Design for humans and agents:</strong> Build with two audiences in mind—ensuring features, APIs, documentation, and error messages serve both people and AI agents.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Customer and data authority:</strong> Connect with customers regularly, serve as an internal advocate for their needs, and define metrics that demonstrate value for users and the business.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Influence across teams:</strong> Build alignment across engineering, design, Product Marketing, support, and leadership.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Go-to-market:</strong> Partner with Product Marketing early so go-to-market strategy helps shape the product, not just the launch.</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>What you bring</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Product management experience:</strong> Proven experience in product management owning a distinct product area, ideally focused on developer platforms, PaaS, or cloud infrastructure.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Technical depth:</strong> Understanding of building, deploying, and running applications in the cloud, with the ability to collaborate closely with infrastructure engineers on multi-tenant architectures or distributed systems.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Software development background:</strong> Familiarity with building software using languages such as Python, Ruby, JavaScript, PHP, Go, or Rust.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>CI/CD, containers &amp; APIs:</strong> Hands-on experience or close collaboration with CI/CD workflows, Docker/OCI container technologies, and a clear vision for intuitive API design.</span></p> </li> <li> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>AI fluency:</strong> Daily use of modern AI tools to research, draft, and prototype workflows, paired with a realistic understanding of where current tools and models fall short.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Agentic development:</strong> A strong perspective on autonomous agent architecture and how agentic workflows are transforming modern software engineering.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Navigating ambiguity:</strong> Comfort with turning unstructured problem spaces into clear strategies and taking thoughtful action even with incomplete information.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Collaborative communication:</strong> Clear written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of listening, building consensus, and uniting teams around a shared vision.</span></p> </li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Data-informed decision making:</strong> Ability to seek out and evaluate data to guide decisions and track success.</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Bonus points for</strong></span></h1> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Enthusiasm for using and testing the platform capabilities you help build.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Experience using Kubernetes, or building self-service platforms on Kubernetes</span></p> </li> </ul> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Where we hire</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in <strong>Germany, Canada, Spain, France, and the UK</strong>. Although we’re unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries.&nbsp;</span></p> <h1><span style="font-size: 14pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>How we hire</strong></span></h1> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We know that a great hire won’t meet every requirement that we’ve outlined. If you can see yourself elevating the team, we want to hear your story. description: Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators. The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly. This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments. What You Will Do Own the product strategy and roadmap for how free users become aware of, experience, and develop intent for Premium, driving consideration, conversion intent, and subscriber growth across segments and markets. Lead the discovery, design, and delivery of subscriber-facing features from early concept through global rollout. Drive experiments that deepen our understanding of what makes users want Premium and measurably move free users closer to a purchase decision. Turn behavioral, funnel, and market data into clear hypotheses, define meaningful success metrics, and build a prioritized experimentation roadmap. Design rigorous A/B experiments to evaluate funnel changes against strong baselines, scaling approaches that demonstrably work across markets and segments. Make pragmatic trade-offs across user value, revenue impact, regional nuance, and operational complexity, knowing when a simple flow change is enough and when a deeper platform capability is needed. Partner with marketing, research, and regional teams to adapt value positioning and messaging for different markets, competitive landscapes, and user needs, including high-growth emerging markets where the path to Premium may look fundamentally different. Communicate strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders, translating funnel mechanics and subscription economics into business impact and strategic direction. You have strong instincts for consumer value and what makes a product feel worth paying for, and understand how perception, positioning, and product experience work together to influence willingness to pay. You can break down the path from awareness to conversion, identify the highest-leverage opportunities, and connect product decisions to downstream revenue outcomes such as ARPU, LTV, and net subscriber growth. HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER

Juro has big ambitions: to become the go-to platform for agreeing and managing contracts globally. And we'll need help doing it.

Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

Eimear (our Director of Finance) is heading off on maternity leave, and we're looking for an interim Finance Director to hold the seat for ~8 months (October to May).

This isn't a caretaker role, and it isn't a pure people-leadership role either. You're a player-coach in FP&A, meaning you’ll:

  • personally run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end,

  • partner with other execs as a peer to shape strategy, and

  • coach a Financial Controller and an Analyst on everything else.

Success means:

  1. Own and run the FY27 FP&A cycle end-to-end: budget, monthly reforecast, board packs, monthly exec business reviews.

  2. Partner with the CEO and exec team as a peer, shaping board and investor reporting and influencing strategic finance decisions as they arise.

  3. Lead the finance team, with an active coaching load on month-end.

We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

WHO WE LOOK FOR

  • You've worked in a B2B SaaS company for a significant part of the last 2 years.

  • You've personally run a full FP&A cycle end-to-end (budget, reforecasts, board reporting), not just contributed to one someone else owned.

  • You're accounting-literate and can support and challenge a controller, even if you're not the one closing the books.

  • You've been the finance owner in a diligence process. That means you've built the data room and held numbers up under external scrutiny.

  • You've partnered directly with execs and a board; not just reporting numbers to them, but shaping and influencing their decisions.

  • You've led a small finance team.

  • You've been hands-on and energised by rolling up your sleeves.

This job likely isn't for you if:

  • You need time and coaching to grow into the role; we need someone who can land running, our CEO won’t have the time to train you.

  • You'd rather direct than build.

  • High-stakes corporate moments (transactions, diligence, board scrutiny) are unfamiliar territory.

  • You've never partnered with execs or led a team.

  • Your FP&A experience is "supporting" rather than owning.

OUR MISSION

Juro exists to help the world agree faster by making it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts.

Frustrated by the absurdly slow process of taking a contract from inception through to agreement, Juro co-founders Richard and Pavel thought there must be a better way. They set out in 2016 to build a flexible, collaborative platform that anyone could use to process a legal contract end-to-end in their browser.

Fast forward 8 years and we have helped our customers process 2 million contracts in over 85 countries. Some of the world’s fastest-growing businesses, like Deliveroo, Remote, and Trustpilot have relied on Juro to help them streamline routine contracts at scale across multiple years of their growth.

description: Do you want to lead the engineering functions that decide how a platform screening over a billion dollars of crypto transactions every week is built and run? Are you a DevOps leader fascinated by the possibilities of both agentic software solutions and the usage of agents in the software delivery lifecycle? Are you looking for a values-led company that cares about the growth of its people as much as the strength of its platform? Elliptic is where ambitious people do the most important work of their careers. We are making crypto safe, secure and scalable, preventing global financial crime, exposing bad actors and protecting the world's financial system as it is being revolutionized. This is work your friends will actually want to hear about. You can expect to work in highly empowered teams, with remarkable breadth and the freedom to turn bold ideas into real impact, supported every step of the way by some of the most brilliant people you have ever called colleagues. The impact you will have: This role provides the people leadership for two connected functions at the heart of how Elliptic engineers. On the DevOps side, you keep a latency-sensitive screening platform dependable, cost-effective and scalable as transaction volume and customer expectations grow. On the AI Platform side, you lead the team that acts as Elliptic's centre of excellence for building AI agents, owning the shared frameworks, patterns, MCP management and evaluation capability that every product team draws on. You are a two-way conduit for that centre of excellence: carrying its best practice out to teams, and helping define what those best approaches should be. Reliability remains foundational to everything Elliptic does, and you will champion strong SRE practices across the business, though the SRE function itself sits outside your direct people-management scope. This is a hands-off, strategy and people-leadership role: you lead and grow the people, set the operating model, and make the calls that shape DevOps and AI Platform at Elliptic. What you will do: Lead, grow and develop the people across two functions, DevOps and AI Platform, owning hiring, levelling, coaching and career development for a combined team of roughly twelve engineers. Set the strategy and operating model for DevOps: release safety, developer experience, observability, cost and the scalability of a latency-sensitive screening platform. Lead the AI Platform function as a centre of excellence, owning the people and operating model behind Elliptic's shared agent-building frameworks and patterns, MCP management, evaluation framework and shared AI infrastructure. Act as a two-way conduit for the centre of excellence: disseminate best practice and reusable approaches out to product teams building their own agents, and channel their feedback back to define and improve those approaches. Partner with the AI Platform technical lead and senior engineers to shape technical direction, bringing people leadership and delivery rather than owning the technical vision single-handedly. Own the cost, scalability and efficiency of the infrastructure as volume grows, bringing a FinOps mindset to infrastructure spend. Champion SRE and reliability practices across the business, partnering closely with the SRE function. Support the infrastructure and process maturity needed for certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC2, working with InfoSec. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: Built trust across both functions and their counterparts, and developed a clear, evidence-based picture of the platform's reliability and cost posture and of how the AI Platform centre of excellence currently works and shares knowledge. Shaped and begun executing a people and hiring strategy across both functions, growing DevOps toward its target and building out the AI Platform and AI infrastructure team. Begun operating as an effective conduit for the centre of excellence, strengthening how agent-building best practice, MCP and evaluation approaches are defined centrally and adopted by product teams. Established a clear point of view on AI SDLC and how the platform enables it, and championed SRE practices across the business. You will be a great fit here if you: Lead through people: you measure your success by the growth and impact of your team, not your own output. Are credible with senior engineers without needing to be the hands-on expert: you ask the sharp question and facilitate the right decision. Are genuinely curious about AI, agents and evaluations, and energised by helping an organisation learn to build with them well. Are honest and pragmatic about timelines and trade-offs, and comfortable owning a long-term build-out across two functions. Care about the mission: providing the infrastructure and intelligence that keep financial institutions safe from crypto crime and sanctions evasion. Our ideal candidate has: A track record of managing DevOps, platform or infrastructure engineers, including hiring and building a growing team. An infrastructure background (cloud, IaC, CI/CD, observability) deep enough to make sound strategic calls and guide senior engineers toward the right ones. Extreme curiosity about AI and budding hands-on experience with AI, agents and evaluations: not necessarily deep expertise, but a real, demonstrated pull toward the space and the judgement to grow into leading it. A strong interest in the nuances of the AI-assisted SDLC, and the conviction that tooling alone does not make engineers more potent. Adoption, practice and guardrails are what turn AI access into real leverage. Kubernetes literacy, grounded in hands-on experience as an engineer, sufficient to reason about the estate and challenge the team's decisions. AI fluency: candidates must be able to demonstrate practical, responsible use of AI in an engineering context and the ability to set team norms for it. We are looking for an active AI promoter who can reason about where AI adds leverage and where it is a liability in a compliance setting. Bonus Points for: Experience leading or building an internal platform, ML platform, developer-experience or enablement function. Hands-on exposure to agent frameworks, MCP, or building and running evaluation frameworks. Experience of a company scaling phase. Exposure to ISO 27001 / SOC2 and what they demand of infrastructure and process. Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems in a regulated or financial context. HODLs Crypto. Core is the Workday and HR platform surface that nearly every People Operations process runs through — pay, leave, employment status, right to work, and multi-country compliance for a global workforce. What you'll be doing

  • Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

  • Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

  • Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

  • Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

  • Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

  • Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

  • Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

  • Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions

  • Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them

title: Graduate program | French market (Paris)
description: Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Quand un utilisateur pose une question, le système la décompose en sous-questions précises, puis déploie des agents spécialisés qui explorent en parallèle codes, jurisprudence, doctrine et textes européens. Chaque document est analysé en profondeur, les liens implicites entre principes juridiques sont identifiés, et le tout est synthétisé dans un rapport structuré où chaque affirmation est sourcée. Ce qui prenait une semaine à une équipe entière se fait pendant une pause café. Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, et redonner aux avocats et aux directions juridiques le temps de se concentrer sur ce qui compte. Nous construisons l'équipe commerciale française, et vous en serez l'un des tout premiers membres. Pourquoi nous rejoindre Un produit qui tient ses promesses : la démo fait le travail. Vos prospects voient la différence en une session, pas après six mois de POC. Un marché en forte demande : tous les cabinets français cherchent une réponse à l'IA, et les usages ne sont pas encore stabilisés. Une équipe qui se construit : vous entrez tôt et vous pesez sur la façon dont on vend. Une vraie école de vente : un parcours structuré, du coaching hebdomadaire et des objectifs clairs à chaque étape. Vos responsabilités Pour soutenir notre croissance, nous lançons un Graduate Program – Sales conçu pour les 3 % de jeunes talents les plus ambitieux. Ce n'est pas un poste junior classique. C'est un parcours accéléré, avec des rotations structurées et un objectif clair : faire de vous un Account Executive performant en 18 mois, avec le soutien de la Lexroom Sales Academy. Vous passerez par quatre rôles consécutifs, chacun avec ses objectifs, son coaching et ses KPI : 3 à 6 mois – SDR (Sales Development Representative) Qualifier les leads inbound. Apprendre les bases de la discovery, la qualification d'opportunités et le passage de relais à l'AE. 6 mois – BDR (Business Development Representative) Apprendre à générer du pipeline à partir de zéro. Maîtriser la prospection, les séquences outbound, le premier contact et la prise de rendez-vous. Le point de bascule Après vos neuf premiers mois, en fonction de vos performances, de vos points forts et des compétences acquises, vous rejoindrez l'une des deux trajectoires suivantes : 6 mois – AE Inbound Gérer les deals inbound sur notre segment juridique. Mener les calls de discovery et les démos, traiter les objections et closer vos premiers clients. Travailler main dans la main avec les AE seniors, le Sales Coach et le Sales Director sur des deals en cours et sur la stratégie. 6 mois – AE Outbound Prendre la responsabilité d'un territoire. Piloter des deals outbound de bout en bout, avec plusieurs interlocuteurs et des cycles plus longs. Contribuer à améliorer les scripts, les séquences et les playbooks au fil de vos apprentissages. Tout au long du programme, vous serez formé et coaché au sein de la Lexroom Sales Academy, avec des modules structurés sur : la méthodologie de vente (discovery, démo, négociation, traitement des objections) ; la gestion du pipeline et du territoire ; l'usage de l'IA dans la vente ; la performance personnelle, le mindset et la communication. Les meilleurs profils seront fast-trackés vers des rôles mid-market, enterprise ou managériaux. Le profil que nous cherchons Jeune diplômé (ou jusqu'à 1 an d'expérience) avec un vrai intérêt pour la vente B2B et la tech / l'IA. Vous avez toujours été parmi les meilleurs dans ce que vous avez fait : études, sport, projets, travail. Excellentes qualités de communication, à l'oral comme à l'écrit. Français langue maternelle (ou C1+), anglais courant (B2 minimum, pour travailler avec les équipes transverses). Drive et résilience : les objectifs ambitieux vous motivent et le "non" ne vous fait pas peur. Vous apprenez vite, vous posez les questions qui dérangent et vous allez chercher le feedback. Vous voulez des responsabilités tôt, pas une ligne "programme graduate" sur votre CV. Ce que nous offrons 45 000 55 000 € OTE , variable non plafonné et accéléré. Equity : un package de stock-options. 3 jours d'onboarding en présentiel à Milan , entièrement pris en charge. Mutuelle d'entreprise (Alan) : prise en charge à 60 % par l'employeur. Titres-restaurant (Swile) : 12 € par jour (pris en charge à 60 % par l'employeur). Pass Navigo : pris en charge à 50 % par l'employeur. Wellpass : abonnement sport & bien-être (cofinancé par l'employeur). Programme Erasmus : 1 semaine par an, vol et logement pris en charge, pour travailler depuis nos bureaux de Madrid, Barcelone, Milan, Rome, Berlin ou Sofia. Modèle hybride : entre le télétravail et notre bureau parisien. Le process Entretien Talent Acquisition : motivation et parcours. Entretien commercial : potentiel et sens commercial. Mise en situation : approche et résilience. Entretien final : valeurs et culture. Offre. Chez Lexroom , nous sommes portés par des ambitions fortes et une exigence d'excellence. Nous construisons quelque chose de grand, et cela demande de l'engagement, du travail et une vraie envie de progresser. Si ce défi vous parle, nous serons ravis de recevoir votre candidature. Compensation: €45K – €55K • €45K – €55K Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant en Informatique - CDD 12 Mois
description: Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain. Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) ! Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé. 🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions. 💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali. Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels. Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne).  Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.   Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.   Vos missions principales : Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides. Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge. Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle. Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.   Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un : Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche. Profil scientifique recherché : Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques. Appétence pour le domaine de la santé. Compétences attendues : Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité. Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets. Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude. Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international. Vos atouts supplémentaires : Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle. Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java). Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique. 🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ? Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde . raw.title: Post-doctorante ou post-doctorant en Informatique - CDD 12 Mois
raw.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge.

  • Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle.

  • Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.

 

Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche.

Profil scientifique recherché :

  • Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques.

  • Appétence pour le domaine de la santé.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité.

  • Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets.

  • Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international.

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle.

  • Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java).

  • Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

· Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

· Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

· Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail.

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

Dans le cadre de sa politique Égalité, Diversité et Inclusion, l’École des Mines de Saint Etienne est un employeur soucieux de l’équité de traitement entre les candidatures.

 Informations complémentaires

·  Date de prise de poste souhaitée : 01/01/2027

·  Rémunération fixée selon le profil du candidat, en fonction des règles définies par le cadre de gestion de l’Institut Mines Télécom.

Location: Paris, France

Contract: Permanent, local and full-time

PUR Description 

PUR is a global B Corp helping companies act for climate, nature and people through nature-based projects. 

Since 2008, we have worked with leading companies to restore ecosystems, support farmers and communities, and build more resilient supply chains. Our projects include agroforestry, regenerative agriculture, reforestation, and ecosystem restoration, across more than 30 countries. 

We work closely with local partners, farmers, cooperatives, NGOs and businesses to design projects that are adapted to each landscape and community. This local approach is key to creating long-term impact — for the climate, biodiversity, soil, water, and livelihoods. 

Today, PUR has more than 200 team members across 16 countries, with key offices in Paris and Toronto. As the world faces growing climate and biodiversity challenges, PUR is helping global companies move from ambition to action. 

 

About the role 

As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and data processing solutions that power analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. You will play a key role in transforming raw project data into reliable, high-quality datasets through robust ETL processes, modern data architectures, and Python-based engineering practices. 

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will ensure that data is accessible, trustworthy, and aligned with analytical requirements while contributing to the continuous improvement of our data platform and cloud-based ecosystem. 

 

Your responsibilities will be, but not limited to: 

 

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python.

  • Build and optimize data ingestion, transformation, and validation processes for large datasets.

  • Design and maintain data models supporting reporting, analytics, and business applications.

  • Implement and monitor data quality controls to ensure reliability and accuracy.

  • Manage and optimize workflows using orchestration tools such as Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure).

  • Support CI/CD, testing, monitoring, and infrastructure-as-code practices (Terraform).

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable and reliable data solutions.

  • Maintain technical documentation and promote data engineering best practices.


We are looking for someone with: 

  • 3-5 years of experience in Data Engineering, with strong Python skills and experience building production-grade ETL pipelines.

  • Strong SQL expertise and solid understanding of relational and analytical databases, data modeling, and data warehousing concepts.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, Prefect, Dagster) and implementing automated testing for data pipelines.

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably Azure) and Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform is a strong plus).

  • Familiarity with AI tools (Claude is a plus).

  • Strong knowledge of Git and software engineering best practices.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, focus on data quality and reliability, and ability to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Fluent English with strong written and verbal communication skills.

Recruitment process :

  1. Interview with the recruiter

  2. Interview with the manager and case study

  3. References check

At PUR, we strive to build inclusive teams and an equitable workplace where our employees feel respected, supported, and empowered. As a global company operating across six continents, we recognize that diversity in the workplace is essential to achieving our mission. 

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, race, gender, colour, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or any other aspect that makes them unique.

PUR is dedicated to providing an accessible environment for all candidates during the application process and for employees during their employment.  If you require accommodation or consideration throughout the interview process, let us know, and we will do our best to support you.

description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost. Why is this role interesting? High-impact scope : You'll work across the full sales organization, from Account Executives to BDRs, Account Management, and Customer Success Managers. Real ownership : You'll own initiatives end to end, from strategy and design to execution and adoption, not just delivery. Builder's playground : You'll have access to a modern stack, combining low-code tools, AI (Dust, Claude), Salesforce, and SQL, to ship things fast and at scale. Tangible results : Recent examples from our roadmap include fully automating slide deck generation for Sales (saving 1,000+ hours per year) and building an AI-powered outbound machine reaching a 15% discovery rate. What will you do with us? You'll own effectiveness initiatives end to end, setting the roadmap, designing the solution, building it, driving execution, and managing change across the organization. You'll spend meaningful time in the field to spot gaps in our sales process, then design smarter workflows by eliminating steps and increasing automation. You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works. You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks. ⭐ Is it you we're looking for? You'll be a great fit for the Revenue Operations team at Alan if you: Have at least 5 years of experience in a similar role (RevOps, Sales Ops, or Sales Effectiveness); Demonstrate strong ownership and project management skills, and are comfortable running initiatives without hand-holding; Have a builder mindset and love being hands-on; Are confident with change management , including shadowing, training, measuring adoption, and iterating; Have at least intermediate SQL queries reading skills . Being able to write and own queries autonomously is a nice to have. Have proven experience with low-code tools and integrations (e.g. Clay, Make, Zapier, or equivalent) to build scalable workflows Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use) Are able to build and maintain pipelines that produce actionable insights, with clear business impact Have excellent verbal and written communication skills; Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English . Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. For this role we are looking to hire within the D-E level range . Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards . Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup . Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes, Biarritz, Madrid or Barcelona. All the tools you need . Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport . Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching : At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture . Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success. If you identify yourself as a woman : Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application! 🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium , blog and Glassdoor page for more info. #LI-DNP Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for new segments:

  • It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

  • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

  • Full working proficiency in French

  • At least advanced level in English

  • An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

  • Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

  • A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

  • Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

  • A prior experience working with senior leadership

  • You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role, we are looking to hire within the E-F level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.
