Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Pre-Sales role ⭐️

Our Pre-Sales team strengthens Alan’s Enterprise and Public sector Sales to better handle the specificities of our largest customers.

Here are the main missions of the team you will join:

  • Master our platform and support Sales team by enabling them with insights, expertise and the relevant tools;

  • Listen and understand prospects’ needs and work internally on how Alan can address them best;

  • Build a thorough understanding of the prospect and assess the level of functional alignment with our offering and capabilities;

  • Participate to RFP submissions and build Alan’s response in collaboration with Sales, Insurance and Product experts;

  • Join the customer acquisition journey to evangelize our services and products;

  • Act as voice of the customer feeding Alan’s platform roadmap;

  • Prepare handover for delightful customers’ onboardings;

  • Eventually coordinate the most complex customer onboardings leveraging your unique knowledge of the customer’s requirements and specificities.

You will actively participate in developing this growing function within Alan and edit the company to make our Sales teams the most successful of all!

Given the growing need for onsite customer engagement, this role requires you to be based in Paris or the Île-de-France region (or within a 2-hour door to door distance with the flexibility to travel to Paris on short notice for customer meetings).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-E level range.

⭐️ You will be a great fit if ⭐️

  • You have 6+ years of experience working in a SaaS environment, including at least 3 in a Pre-Sales / Sales Engineering / Solution Consultant role.

  • You are highly experienced in end-to-end procurement projects (buyer or supplier side) with involvement in RFI’s, RFQ’s and RFP’s;

  • You have a talent for quickly getting to the root cause of customers concern through active listening and requirements elicitation;

  • You are assertive and know how to handle objections in a complex environment;

  • You master the art of pitching a product with transparency and without overselling its capabilities ;

  • You have the ability to break down complex issues and identify product gaps to define the best product solutions;

  • You thrive at high level stakeholders’ management;

  • You excel at prioritizing tasks while living up to commitments;

  • You love teamwork and are always eager to learn and grow;

  • You are fluent in both French and English;

It would be even better if you have:

  • Experience in the French Public Sector;

  • Experience in HRIS ecosystems and Payroll solutions;

  • Experience in Insurance or Health platforms.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

What we're looking for

Must-have - Technical/hard skills:

  • 4-5+ years in IT engineering, platform, systems or corporate engineering, with real ownership of production-facing systems

  • Depth in at least one area (platform & automation, identity, endpoint & security) and demonstrated range beyond it.

  • You write code: not necessarily as a full-time software engineer, but Python, APIs and pull requests in a shared repo should feel normal

  • Structured problem-solving: diagnoses methodically, asks the right clarifying questions, thinks about failure modes and rollback

  • Comfort with regulated environments: health data, ACPR, ISO 27001, HDS

  • Automation & AI appetite: uses AI tools smartly to accelerate their own delivery, with an instinct for what should be automated or delegated to AI rather than repeated

Must-have - Behavioral / soft skills:

  • Ownership & autonomy: drives topics forward without hand-holding, including when they cross into someone else's perimeter

  • Written communication: Alan is written-first; decisions get argued in public documents and challenged by people outside your team

  • Pragmatic judgment: balances "perfect" vs. "good enough", decides with incomplete information

  • Documentation culture: reduces bus factor through clear documentation and knowledge sharing

Nice-to-have skills / Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with an internal provisioning or IdP-driven automation platform (Okta Workflows, Rippling, Workato, or something you built yourself)

  • Kandji or another MDM at scale

  • Cloudflare Zero Trust / WARP, Datadog

  • Audit remediation experience (ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS)

  • Multi-country rollouts, or IT integration after an acquisition

  • Having mentored, coached or led a (small) crew

  • Health or healthtech ecosystem familiarity

Languages: Fluent English & Professional French

Compensation: €61K – €83K • €45K – €120K Equity

description: Participe à notre journée exceptionnelle de recrutement pour rejoindre notre Sales Graduate Program chez Alan ! Tu es diplômé(e) d'un Master avec maximum 2 ans d'expérience et tu souhaites débuter ta carrière dans la vente ? Le jeudi 8 Octobre 2026 , Alan t’invite à une journée de recrutement exclusive dans nos bureaux parisiens. Nous ouvrons seulement 24 places pour participer à cette journée, avec l’opportunité unique de décrocher ton CDI au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program. Saisis ta chance de lancer ta carrière en tant que Business Development Representative (BDR) dès Janvier 2027 (ou selon tes disponibilités) , d’acquérir des bases solides en vente, et de tracer ta voie vers des rôles Sales seniors chez Alan en 18 à 24 mois ! Pourquoi participer ? Vis une expérience unique & décroche ta place dans notre Sales Graduate Program : un véritable tremplin pour propulser ta carrière dans la vente. Plonge dans l’univers d’Alan : découvre notre vision et notre ambition au contact direct de nos Alaners. Bénéficie d’un process rapide & transparent : avec une réponse sous 48h à l’issue de la journée. Plonge au cœur du métier de BDR chez Alan : découvre concrètement ce rôle à travers des mises en situation et des échanges privilégiés avec l’équipe. Le processus de recrutement : 📅 Date de l’événement : Jeudi 8 Octobre 2026 📍 Lieu : Siège d’Alan : 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris ⏰ Date limite de candidature : Jeudi 1 Octobre 2026 📈 Les étapes : Nous étudions toutes les candidatures reçues pour sélectionner les meilleurs profils. Si ton profil est retenu, nous t’appellerons pour t’annoncer la nouvelle et échanger brièvement sur tes motivations. Tu recevras un cas pratique à réaliser chez toi : des questions de motivation et un pitch vidéo à enregistrer. Les candidat(e)s retenu(e)s seront invité(e)s à rejoindre notre journée exclusive au siège d’Alan, avec au programme une étude de cas et des entretiens. À l’issue de cette journée, nous donnons notre réponse en 48h, et les profils sélectionnés rejoindront l’aventure Alan au sein de notre Sales Graduate Program à partir de Janvier 2027 ! ⭐️ Tout savoir sur notre Sales Graduate Program Le principe ? Sur une période de 18 à 24 mois , nous t’offrons l'opportunité d'évoluer au sein du rôle de Business Development Representative (BDR) en acquérant progressivement des compétences plus avancées dans la vente. Phase 1 : Apprends les bases du métier de BDR : prospection, compréhension du marché, création d’opportunités, échanges avec des décideurs. Phase 2 : Développe ton leadership : en tant que BDR, prends des responsabilités transverses telles que le recrutement, le coaching des nouveaux, l’animation de formations et la gestion de projets. Phase 3 : Spécialise-toi : concentre-toi soit sur la prospection des grands comptes (plus complexes et stratégiques), soit sur les PME, en menant des rendez-vous de découverte et des démonstrations produit. Cette progression au sein du rôle de BDR te permettra de développer des compétences commerciales complètes qui te prépareront à une future mobilité interne en tant qu'Account Executive ou Inbound Sales. Envie d’en savoir plus sur le Sales Graduate Program ? 👉 Découvre les coulisses de la première promotion ici 👉 Découvre l'équipe en vidéo ici 👉 Découvre comment on a conçu le programme ici 👉 Lis le témoignage inspirant de Diane sur pourquoi la prospection est un art stratégique 👉 Explore notre approche unique de la vente 💥 Es-tu notre candidat idéal ? Chez Alan, notre devise est "nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles" : nous valorisons les compétences interpersonnelles plus que techniques. Nous croyons que ton potentiel est ce qui compte vraiment. Tu seras un bon fit pour rejoindre l'équipe Sales d'Alan si : Tu détiens un Master d'une école de commerce, avec jusqu'à deux ans d'expérience professionnelle ; Tu montres un intérêt fort pour la vente, et détiens idéalement une première expérience dans ce domaine Tu es enthousiaste, animé(e) par notre mission, et désireux(se) de partager notre ambition ; Tu es team player, organisé(e), et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches simultanément ; Tu es désireux(se) d'apprendre et de grandir dans de nouveaux rôles ; Tu es basé(e) à (ou prêt(e) à déménager à) Paris ou Bordeaux Prêt(e) à rejoindre notre Business Development Representative - Graduate Program ? Pour cette opportunité, nous visons à recruter dans la fourchette de niveau A2-B0 . 🐼 Qui sommes-nous ? La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme de soin pour tous. Notre mission est d'aider les gens à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans tout en aidant les employeurs à être fiers, transformant les avantages santé d'un centre de coûts en leur investissement le plus précieux. Nous construisons un partenaire santé intégré qui unit harmonieusement assurance et prestations de soins intelligentes en un seul système. En connectant tous les aspects du soin - privé, public et direct consommateur - nous créons une expérience santé centrée sur nos membres. Grâce à un engagement profond, nous donnons à chacun les moyens de surmonter les obstacles de santé du quotidien et de vivre plus sainement. 🚀 Comment on s'y prend ? Les personnes qui rejoignent Alan sont souvent surprises et ravies par notre méthode de travail innovante. Nous avons un ensemble de valeurs culturelles qui guident notre approche du travail : La mission est notre priorité — Nous pensons à long terme et sommes des optimistes méthodiques qui prenons des risques, recherchant avant tout la réussite de notre mission. Responsabilité partagée — Chacun est responsable de ses décisions et de ses résultats. Transparence radicale — Toutes les informations sont accessibles et consignées par écrit, afin que chacun puisse prendre les meilleures décisions de manière asynchrone. En constante évolution — Du feedback direct, positif et bienveillant, associé à une prise en charge de son propre développement personnel. 🙌 Avantages & Bénéfices Chez Alan, nous croyons qu' être en bonne santé est un besoin fondamental, et cela commence avec nos employés. C'est pourquoi les Alaners bénéficient d'un environnement stimulant et d'avantages garantissant qu'ils sont heureux, efficaces et ne passent que du temps de qualité avec leurs collègues. Par conséquent, nous offrons : Récompenses équitables . Des packages d'equity généreux complètent ton salaire de base. Bureau flexible . Espace de bureau incroyable dans notre HQ à Paris ou hub de co-working sponsorisé à Bordeaux. Tous les outils dont tu as besoin . Équipement haut de gamme : Macbook Pro, clavier, support laptop, écran, et casque anti-bruit. Politique de vacances flexible et horaires de travail flexibles . Organise ton temps comme tu le souhaites. Assurance santé complète - prise en charge à 100% pour toi et tes enfants, 90-100% pour les partenaires selon ton pays (contrats permanents uniquement) . Transport . Avantages de transport spécifiques au pays. Opportunités d'apprentissage et de formation. Politique de formation très flexible, livres gratuits et budget pour assister et parler lors de conférences si l'opportunité se présente. Croissance personnelle par le coaching : Chez Alan, le coaching n'est pas juste un avantage - c'est au cœur de qui nous sommes. Chaque Alaner est accompagné par un coach dédié dès le premier jour, qui aide à maximiser son impact, nourrir l'engagement, et naviguer les valeurs d'Alan pour développer son plein potentiel. Congé parental. Congé parental étendu pour tous les nouveaux parents. Note importante : nous recrutons des personnes, pas des rôles. Si tu es intéressé(e) par cette opportunité mais ne coches pas toutes les cases, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles. Tout le monde devrait se sentir libre de postuler car cela ne peut qu'apporter apprentissages ou succès. Si tu t'identifies comme une femme : Savais-tu que les recherches montrent que les femmes postulent souvent, uniquement, quand elles remplissent 100% des exigences ? Rappelle-toi, c'est juste un guide, pas une checklist. Nous serons ravis de recevoir ta candidature ! 🔖 Consulte nos pages À propos d'Alan , Medium et Carrières , ainsi que notre blog et page Glassdoor pour plus d'infos.   • Have wide knowledge of Alan's processes, equipment, and tools

  • Contribute to a build project alongside an IT Engineer

First year

  • Be regarded as an expert on at least one topic beyond the oncall rotation (e.g. MDM, SaaS admin, compliance documentation)

  • Ship automation or self-service projects that measurably reduce IT toil, with limited guidance

3 years

  • Lead medium to high-complexity IT projects end-to-end

Build trusted relationships with prospective customers and clearly communicate the value of broader supplier access, competitive pricing, product selection, and marketplace efficiency. Own the customer journey throughout the first 90 days, helping new accounts move from initial searches and quotations to their first orders and repeat purchases. Focus on customer activation and long-term value rather than simply closing and handing off newly signed accounts. Partner with SDRs to ensure strong qualification and effective handoffs before and after demonstrations. Experience selling solutions based on customer workflows and business outcomes rather than relying on feature-led product presentations. Excellent discovery, presentation, demonstration, negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills. Commercially minded and comfortable managing pricing discussions, contractual terms, and pushback from customers and multiple stakeholders. Strong operational discipline and willingness to own post-sale activities such as KYC, compliance, onboarding, and activation. Ability to manage a pipeline effectively, prioritize opportunities, and maintain accurate forecasts in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused approach with the ability to build credible, long-term relationships with businesses of different sizes. Strong ownership, resilience, adaptability, and attention to detail, with the ability to maintain momentum across multiple deals and customer journeys. Excellent communication skills in French and English , with the ability to communicate confidently with international customers and internal stakeholders. With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

TL;DR: We’re looking for a hands-on Talent Lead to own and build our hiring function from scratch. You’ll personally drive hiring across the company, build scalable recruiting processes, track hiring performance, and work closely with the Head of People and hiring managers across GTM, Ops, Research, and Product.

 

About us

White Circle is an AI Safety company building the safety, reliability, and optimization layer for AI systems. At the core of our platform are policies – simple natural-language rules that define what an AI model should and shouldn’t do. We automatically test, enforce, and continuously improve these policies at scale.

  • We’ve raised $11M from top funds, founders, and senior leaders at OpenAI, Anthropic, HuggingFace, Mistral, DeepMind, Datadog, Sentry, and others

  • We process over one hundred million API calls every month

  • We fine-tune and train our own LLMs so they run faster and cheaper than any open or proprietary model

We’re a small, highly focused team. If you want to work deeply on hard problems, see your work ship to production quickly, and influence how AI safety is actually built – you’re the one we need.

 

You will:

  • Own and run the hiring process end-to-end (sourcing, screening, interviews, and closing)

  • Personally source and hire candidates across the company (this is a hands-on recruiting role)

  • Build our hiring processes and infrastructure from scratch, including interview loops, scorecards, pipelines, and candidate tracking

  • Work closely with hiring managers to define roles, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles

  • Drive hiring across a wide range of functions, including GTM, Ops, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Lead international hiring across the US, EU, UK, and other markets as we expand

  • Build and maintain hiring metrics and reporting, including pipeline conversion, time to hire, source performance, and offer acceptance

  • Use hiring data to identify bottlenecks and continuously improve the recruiting process

  • Build and maintain strong sourcing channels across different functions and geographies

  • Develop a strong candidate experience and represent White Circle throughout the hiring process

  • Help define and improve our approach to hiring, including how we assess candidates and make hiring decisions

  • Partner with leadership on long-term talent planning and hiring strategy

 

You’ll fit right in if you:

  • Have several years of experience running hiring at a startup, ideally in an early-stage or high-growth environment

  • Have personally hired a meaningful number of people and are comfortable owning the full recruiting process yourself

  • Have built hiring processes and recruiting operations from scratch

  • Have experience hiring across multiple functions, including GTM, Operations, Research, Product, and Engineering

  • Have experience with international hiring across multiple countries and markets

  • Are comfortable working directly with leadership and senior hiring managers

  • Are highly data-driven and comfortable tracking and analysing recruiting metrics

  • Are an excellent sourcer and know how to find strong candidates beyond simply posting jobs

  • Communicate clearly and build strong relationships with both candidates and hiring managers

  • Are comfortable operating independently in an environment where processes are still being built

  • Speak and write fluent English (C1+)

A big plus:

  • Experience hiring for AI, ML, and Research roles

  • Experience building a recruiting function as the first or one of the first talent hires

  • Experience hiring in the US, EU, and UK

  • Experience with employer branding and building a strong talent pipeline

  • Experience using AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, research, or recruiting ops

 

Why White Circle

  • Meaningful equity package

  • Paid time off in line with your local regulations, no matter where you work from

  • All the hardware, tools, and services you need

  • Covered subscriptions for AI agents

  • Team off-sites twice a year: we’ve recently been to the Alps, Saint-Tropez, and Mabella

 

How we hire

  1. Introductory call with Head of People (25 min)

  2. Practical Recruitment Exercise with Head of People (60 min)

  3. Final conversation with our CEO (45 min)

Please submit your application in English.

title: AI Enablement Lead [gn] Data Intelligence
description: The AI Enablement Team is the catalyst for internal transformation and product acceleration across Actian. In the modern data landscape, AI is not a siloed experimental lab; it is a core capability that must be embedded into our product DNA and our engineering workflows. We are looking for an AI Enablement Lead who will architect, scale, and own our AI enablement strategy end-to-end. You are not a theoretical researcher or a passive prompt engineer; you are a highly practical, technical driver who builds the foundational platforms, tooling, and frameworks that allow other product and engineering teams to deploy AI safely, rapidly, and at scale. You will democratize AI across the organization, establish modern LLMOps/MLOps practices, and directly impact the Actian Data Intelligence Platform by introducing agentic workflows, intelligent data pipelines, and cutting-edge capabilities. Core Responsibilities: Internal AI tooling: Design and maintain the core AI orchestration layers, centralized API gateways, and reusable frameworks (e.g., advanced RAG architectures, agentic frameworks) for company-wide consumption. Product AI Integration: Collaborate directly with core engineering teams to embed production-ready generative AI and machine learning features into the Actian Data Intelligence Platform. LLMOps & Governance Infrastructure: Establish strict guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and monitoring tools to track model performance, bias, data privacy, and security across all AI implementations. Cost & Latency Optimization: Actively monitor and manage cloud and API compute spend (token management, open-source vs. commercial models) and optimize execution latency for production AI features. Cross-Functional Upskilling: Lead workshops, design blueprints, and create documentation to empower non-AI engineering teams to build and maintain their own AI-driven features confidently. Rapid Prototyping (PoC to Production): Drive the engineering execution of high-impact AI proof-of-concepts, ensuring they are built with production-grade code that scales seamlessly. Standardization of Tooling: Define and enforce the organization's official AI stack, from vector database selection and vector embeddings strategies to semantic caching mechanisms. Vendor & Open-Source Strategy: Evaluate and manage partnerships with AI model providers and lead the technical assessment of cutting-edge open-source models to keep Actian at the vanguard of innovation. Data-Driven Impact Tracking: Define and track operational metrics for the AI Enablement function, such as developer adoption rates, reduction in time-to-market for AI features, and ROI of implemented AI tools. Qualifications & Profile: Technical Background: Strong background as a Senior AI/ML Engineer, LLMOps Engineer, or Software Architect who has successfully built and scaled AI-powered applications in enterprise SaaS or complex data platforms. AI & Engineering Mastery: Deep technical expertise in Python or Go, semantic search, vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, pgvector), orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex), and fine-tuning or prompt engineering of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). Extreme Ownership: High-agency mindset. You don’t wait for product teams to ask for AI capabilities; you proactively build the frameworks that solve their bottlenecks before they even identify them. Software Engineering Rigor: You treat AI development as software engineering. You understand CI/CD, unit testing for AI (evaluation datasets), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and clean code architecture. Influence Without Authority: Exceptional leadership and communication skills. You can inspire and align disparate engineering teams around a shared technical vision without being their direct line manager. raw.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Mistral, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they achieve their goals using Mistral’s solutions. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success. 

This role is ideal for those who excel in customer-facing environments, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about turning customer success into business impact.

What You Will Do

Customer Success Ownership

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they maximize the value of Mistral’s AI solutions.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and tailoring solutions to meet their needs.

  • Lead customer onboarding, adoption, and ongoing engagement to drive product usage and satisfaction.

  • Monitor customer health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address challenges to prevent churn.

  • Collaborate with Sales to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and usage patterns.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to gather customer feedback and influence the product roadmap.

  • Develop and deliver customer training, enablement programs, and best practices to drive adoption.

  • Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) to align on goals, challenges, and success metrics.

Strategic Customer Guidance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding them on how to leverage Mistral’s AI solutions to achieve their business outcomes.

  • Work closely with Support and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, from deployment to production.

  • Create and execute customer success plans with clear KPIs, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Advocate for customer needs internally, ensuring their voice is heard in product and strategic discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer insights with Product, Sales, and Engineering teams to inform product improvements and strategic initiatives.

  • Clear obstacles for customers during deployment and adoption phases, accelerating time-to-value.

  • Support renewal processes, including contract negotiations, expansion discussions, and coordination with internal teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Account Management, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical or SaaS environment.

  • Proven ability to manage enterprise customer relationships, with a focus on driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

  • Experience working with technical products, with the ability to engage confidently with Data, IT, and Engineering teams.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.

  • Business acumen: Ability to identify upsell and expansion opportunities while ensuring customer success.

  • Technical aptitude: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is a plus; ability to understand and discuss technical requirements is essential.

  • Hands-on, customer-centric, collaborative, and organized, with a passion for solving complex challenges.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

description: Hi, we’re Back Market. We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new . We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new. Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have. Are you ready to join us? Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth. You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient. This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Backend + Frontend)
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a  Senior Full-Stack Engineer  to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll work across our entire stack: Java backend services and the TypeScript/Angular frontend that power Soda Cloud. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll own features end-to-end, talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship from database to UI without waiting for hand-offs. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side. What You'll Do Build features end-to-end: backend APIs, database changes, frontend UI, and ship them to production yourself. Design and implement backend services for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. Work with relational databases (MySQL): schema design, query optimization, data modeling. Build frontend features that are clean, fast, and don't get in the way. Optimize performance across the stack and write tests at every layer (unit, integration, e2e). Build agentic features into the product: LLM-powered workflows that help users find, understand, and fix data issues. Improve our systems for agentic development: agent instructions, skills, and the test feedback loops that make agents effective across the codebase. Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here. Hiring Process CV screen 20-minute phone screen First technical interview (45 min) Second technical interview (60 min) Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years building software at a product company : you've owned meaningful parts of a real production system. Strong Java : REST APIs, database interactions, async processing. TypeScript and a modern frontend framework : Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud). Frontend fundamentals : complex UIs, component architecture, state management, performance, responsive design. Solid SQL in a backend context : schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse. Testing as a habit : you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright). Architectural judgment : you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack. DevOps fluency : containers, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, comfortable on Linux. Agentic engineering : you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high. Independence : you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries. Fluent English. Good to Have Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience. An eye for design: you can spot a misaligned pixel. Python: our data engineering stack runs on it. Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users. Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Ownership from day one : if you see a bottleneck, you remove it. International culture : colleagues in 12+ countries. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. Your daily tasks will involve: 

  • Translating the strategic growth priorities defined by the Chief Customer Officer into focused business development plans for selected verticals, markets, and target accounts. 
  • Leveraging your established network and market credibility to secure access to senior decision-makers and create new opportunities with high-potential luxury and premium brands.
